2608.08736.title: FitAQA: A Benchmark of Fitness Action Quality Assessment for Multimodal Large Language Models
2608.08736.paper_summary: Fitness Action Quality Assessment (AQA) is important for intelligent sports training, yet the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in this setting remain underexplored. Existing benchmarks rely on action-specific annotation schemes and focus primarily on final assessment outputs, offering limited insight into how models assess exercise quality. We introduce FitAQA, a systematic benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in fitness AQA, containing 2,219 videos and 5,512 QA instances across 30 bodyweight exercises. In collaboration with experts in sports science, we develop a unified form error taxonomy that defines 38 recurring form errors within six complementary quality dimensions: alignment, symmetry, stability, coordination, tempo, and completeness. This taxonomy provides a shared assessment framework across different exercises. FitAQA further formulates three evaluation tasks: perception for recognizing relevant visual evidence, judgement for combining that evidence with domain knowledge to assess execution correctness, and temporal grounding for localizing form errors over time. Extensive evaluation shows that current MLLMs still struggle to assess exercise quality comprehensively and localize form errors precisely. Controlled experiments further indicate that visual perception is a key bottleneck, as judgement performance improves substantially when ground-truth perceptual evidence is provided. The dataset and evaluation code will be made publicly available.
2608.08736.paper_summary_zh: 健身動作質量評估（AQA）對於智能運動訓練至關重要，但多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在這一領域的能力仍然未被充分探索。現有的基準依賴於特定動作的標註方案，並主要集中在最終評估結果上，對模型如何評估運動質量提供了有限的洞見。我們引入了FitAQA，這是一個系統性的基準，用於評估健身AQA中的MLLMs，包含2,219個視頻和5,512個QA實例，涵蓋30種自體重運動。與運動科學專家合作，我們開發了一個統一的形式錯誤分類法，定義了六個互補質量維度中的38種重複出現的形式錯誤：對齊、對稱、穩定性、協調性、節奏和完整性。這個分類法提供了一個跨不同運動的共享評估框架。FitAQA進一步制定了三個評估任務：感知，用於識別相關的視覺證據；判斷，將該證據與領域知識結合以評估執行的正確性；以及時間定位，用於隨時間定位形式錯誤。廣泛的評估顯示，當前的MLLMs仍然難以全面評估運動質量並精確定位形式錯誤。控制實驗進一步表明，視覺感知是關鍵瓶頸，因為當提供真實的感知證據時，判斷性能顯著提高。數據集和評估代碼將公開提供。
